notes.title: Update notes for June 21st
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Level timer will now record even if hidden
[*] The hat on level 72 will no longer kill you
[*] The elevator in level 93 no longer takes some of the wall with it
[*] Right CTRL and shift can now be used for abilities
[/list]

notes.title: BULLET is now available!
notes.notes:
After a long wait BULLET is now available to play. 
[b]Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy the game.[/b]

notes.title: The Demo is Now Available!
notes.notes:
The free demo for Bullet is now available! 

Enjoy the beginning of the game and get a taste of what the full game has to offer.
